title: Business Development Associate (BDA)
description:
Job Description

Anhet Technologies is looking for motivated and enthusiastic candidates to join our team as Business Development Associates (BDA).

Responsibilities

* Generate leads through calls, online research, and other channels.
* Make outbound calls and communicate with potential clients.
* Identify prospective customers and understand their business requirements.
* Follow up with leads and maintain strong client relationships.
* Schedule client meetings and support business development activities.
* Maintain lead information and update follow-up records.
* Work with the team to achieve business development targets.

Required Skills

* Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence in cold calling and client interaction.
* Interest in sales, lead generation, and business development.
* Good follow-up and relationship-building skills.
* Basic computer knowledge and willingness to learn.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their resumes at **hr@anhet.co**.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
fit_rationale: Target role fit: 98/100. Focus: B2B sales & outbound pipeline alignment (Pencil Mark / AERO India), AI data annotation & evaluation alignment (Instawork AI Data).
